title: Dual Government & 1770 Famine
quote: Company: real power, no responsibility; Nawab: responsibility, but no power or funds

boxes.title: Basis & why "dual"
items: **Second Treaty of Allahabad (1765)**: **Shah Alam II** gave Diwani; tribute **₹26 lakh**
Worked through **Naib Diwans**: ==**Muhammad Reza Khan** (Bengal, Murshidabad)==, **Raja Shitab Rai** (Bihar, Patna)
Why: hide imperial ambitions; avoid **British Parliament**'s scrutiny
Other European companies kept paying duties to "Nawab"; lack of British manpower

boxes.title: Consequences
steps: Weavers forced to sell cheap; handicrafts decline
Wealth drain: surplus revenue buys exports

boxes.title: Bengal Famine of 1770
items: Causes: monsoon failure; ==revenue collected in cash==; grain exported
Deaths: about **10 million** (UPSC) ⚠ other notes: about two million; about one-third of population
Company: little or no relief; collection continued

boxes.title: Abolition by Hastings (1772)
items: "Tore the mask of Mughal sovereignty"; right of conquest
Stopped **₹26 lakh**; **Allahabad**, **Kora** sold to Nawab of **Awadh**

cards.title: Sanyasi (Fakir) Revolt 1763-1800
lines: Leaders: **Majnum Shah, Bhawani Pathak, Devi Chaudhurani**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Reza Khan = Deputy Diwan of Murshidabad (BPSC 2001)
First Governor of Bengal **Clive (1758)**; last = Hastings; first Governor-General = **Hastings (1773)**
